Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Sat, Nov 14 7:46am to 6:07pm; Sun, Nov 15 7:48am to 6:06pm; Mon, Nov 16 7:49am to 6:05pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Sat, Nov 14 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Southeast is blowing, a touch lighter than the page. Boundary Bay reads 14 gusting 17 right now (page 17) and Sand Heads is SE 14 to 16.

Boundary Bay could work but weeds may be an issue if you are foiling until about 5:30pm, building toward 18 to 21 late, with the tide above 11ft all day. Tsawwassen south side, same window. Check before driving: Sand Heads still SE 14 or more means go. Point Atkinson is E 19, so Erwin should be about 14 and gusty but super high tide at 10:30 will make it challenging to get in and out. 

I’m hoping that SE will reach East Beach as there is no weeds there but so far the wind line looks further west and hitting boundary bay better.

EC marine forecast, Howe Sound (issued 04:00 PM PCT 14 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Tonight and Sunday. Wind light increasing to northerly outflow 15 to 25 knots this evening then becoming southerly inflow 20 to 30 late overnight. Wind diminishing to southerly inflow 10 to 20 Sunday morning then becoming northerly outflow 10 to 20 Sunday evening. Strong wind warning program has ended for the season.

Wind easterly 15 to 25 knots increasing to southeast 25 to 35 this evening then becoming southeast 30 to 40 late overnight. Wind diminishing to south 15 to 20 early Sunday morning then backing to southeast 5 to 15 Sunday afternoon except southeast 20 to 25 south of Tsawwassen Sunday evening. Strong wind warning program has ended for the season.
